p: Eloth: He fortified it and made it strong: this city was also called Elath and Elanon near the Red sea.
Zechariah: This was not the Zechariah that was the son of Jehoiada, but some other prophet of that name.
he sought the LORD: For God never forsakes any who seek him, and therefore man is the cause of his own destruction.
gifts to Uzziah: That is, they paid tribute in a sign of subjection.
turning of the wall: Where the wall or tower turns.
Carmel: That is, in mount Carmel, or as the word signifies in the fruitful field, it is also taken for a green ear of corn when it is full, Le 2:14.
number of the chief of the: Of the chief officers of the king's house, or of the captains and sergeants for war.
was lifted up to his destruction: Thus prosperity causes men to trust in themselves and by forgetting him who is the author of it, procure their own punishment.

go out of the sanctuary: Though his zeal seemed to be good and also his intention, yet because they were not governed by the word of God, he did wickedly and was therefore both justly resisted and also punished.
several house: According to the commandment of the Lord, Le 13:46.
is a leper: Therefore was buried apart in the same field but not in the same sepulchre with his predecessors.
